description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kosgoda, Kuruvita D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620275 (24/0683)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
